headword: {学術会議|がくじゅつかいぎ}

definitions.explanation: A formal gathering where researchers and scholars present and discuss their work.
An organized body of scholars that advises on scientific or academic policy. Most notably, the Science Council of Japan.

examples.japanese: {国際|こくさい}{学術会議|がくじゅつかいぎ}に{参加|さんか}した。
examples.english: I participated in an international academic conference.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}の{学術会議|がくじゅつかいぎ}で{論文|ろんぶん}を{発表|はっぴょう}する{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: I plan to present a paper at next month's academic conference.

examples.japanese: その{学術会議|がくじゅつかいぎ}には{世界中|せかいじゅう}から{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}が{集|あつ}まった。
examples.english: Researchers from around the world gathered at the academic conference.

examples.japanese: {日本学術会議|にほんがくじゅつかいぎ}が{声明|せいめい}を{出|だ}した。
examples.english: The Science Council of Japan issued a statement.

examples.japanese: {学術会議|がくじゅつかいぎ}の{会員|かいいん}{選出|せんしゅつ}が{議論|ぎろん}を{呼|よ}んだ。
examples.english: The selection of council members sparked debate.

examples.japanese: {学術会議|がくじゅつかいぎ}は{政府|せいふ}に{政策提言|せいさくていげん}を{行|おこな}う{役割|やくわり}を{担|にな}っている。
examples.english: The academic council plays the role of making policy recommendations to the government.

notes:
A compound of {学術|がくじゅつ} (academic; scholarly) and {会議|かいぎ} (conference; meeting). The most prominent usage in Japan is {日本学術会議|にほんがくじゅつかいぎ} (Science Council of Japan), an advisory body to the government that has been the subject of political controversy in recent years.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国際|こくさい}{学術会議|がくじゅつかいぎ}: international academic conference
- {日本学術会議|にほんがくじゅつかいぎ}: Science Council of Japan
- {学術会議|がくじゅつかいぎ}に{参加|さんか}する: to attend an academic conference
- {学術会議|がくじゅつかいぎ}で{発表|はっぴょう}する: to present at an academic conference

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {学会|がっかい}: academic society; conference — more commonly used for regular discipline-specific conferences and the professional associations that host them
- シンポジウム: symposium — a smaller, discussion-focused academic gathering
- {研究会|けんきゅうかい}: study group; research meeting — a less formal academic gathering
